effects.does: Opens the Clara assistant or summary panel.
effects.affects: Nothing unless the assistant is used to update event content.
effects.check: Click Ask Clara and verify that a Clara panel opens.

effects.does: Opens a control for adding file attachments.
effects.affects: Adds attachment data to the event when a file is selected.
effects.check: Click Add Attachments and verify that a file-selection control opens.

effects.does: Opens the terms and conditions editor.
effects.leadsTo: Terms and Conditions drawer or dialog
effects.check: Click Add T&Cs and verify that the terms editor opens.

effects.does: Cannot save the event as a draft because the required template and BOQ item prerequisites are not met.
effects.affects: Nothing while disabled; when enabled it would create or update a draft project.
effects.check: Verify the button is disabled before selecting a template and adding a BOQ item.

effects.does: Attempts to publish the event, but it is currently blocked by the missing template and BOQ upload.
effects.affects: When enabled, creates the event and moves it into its published or active flow.
effects.check: Verify Publish cannot proceed while the template and BOQ prerequisites are missing.

effects.does: Opens the auction strategy configuration with ranking by lot selected or configurable.
effects.affects: Changes the auction strategy and lot-level closing or evaluation configuration.
effects.check: Click Rank on lot and verify that the strategy drawer shows lot ranking settings.

effects.does: Opens the template selector for choosing a BOQ template.
effects.affects: Sets the event template and enables template-dependent event configuration and actions.
effects.check: Click Select Templates and verify that available BOQ templates are listed.

effects.affects: Adds or removes audience companies or vendors for the event.
effects.check: Click Participants and verify that the event participant list can be viewed or edited.

effects.does: Cannot be opened because the event prerequisites are incomplete.
effects.affects: Nothing while disabled; when configured it would expose savings settings or data.
effects.check: Verify Savings remains disabled before a template and BOQ item are provided.

effects.does: Cannot be opened because the required event setup is incomplete.
effects.affects: Nothing while disabled; when enabled it would open the event's terms and conditions configuration.
effects.check: Verify Terms & Conditions remains disabled until the required template and BOQ data are present.

effects.does: Cannot be edited from this state because the event schedule is not yet configured.
effects.affects: Nothing while disabled; when enabled it would change the event timing or duration.
effects.check: Verify the schedule control cannot be opened before the template and BOQ setup is complete.

effects.does: Keeps the event in Auction mode and shows the auction configuration view.
effects.affects: Sets or preserves the stage mode as auction and applies auction-specific settings.
effects.check: Verify Auction is highlighted and auction settings are displayed.

effects.does: Navigates back to the Events area.
effects.check: Click Events and verify that the Events listing opens.

effects.control: Enter the title of the project
effects.does: Accepts the project title entered by the buyer.
effects.affects: Updates the event or project title that is sent in the project payload and shown during publishing.
effects.check: Enter a title and verify that the field retains it and the title appears in the publish flow.

effects.control: Search vendors you want to add
effects.does: Cannot search for or add vendors because participant selection is disabled before the required event setup is complete.
effects.affects: Nothing while disabled; when enabled it would update the event audience participants.
effects.check: Verify the vendor selector is disabled and cannot accept a vendor search.

`draftStageIds` without `projectId` → single draft stage is loaded and its title becomes the project title; with `projectId` → every listed stage is loaded and the last one is selected — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:2244-2257, 1157-1161, 1437-1445

Shown only when not RFQ→Auction, `allow_draft_project_creation` on, not (service-RFP grouping AND `groupServiceActivitiesInRfp`), auctions not routed to the auction team, and the current stage is not recurring — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:292-296, 3343-3345
Disabled with tooltip "Please select template for <stage title>" for any non-RFP stage without a template, or "Please add line items" — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:1457-1481

Publish never stores the returned stage uuids (only Save as draft does), so a retry after a failed project PATCH (e.g. 712) POSTs every stage again — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:1826-1839 vs 1516-1536

Footer buttons disabled until a template and at least one product exist (RFI: template data), tooltip " Please choose a template and add a product"; never disabled for RFP — src/views/eventCreation/eventCreation.jsx:407-411, 2374-2381, 2428

Changing an existing template asks "Do you really want to change the template?" (project) / "Changing template will reset data. Are you sure?" (quick-create), OK "Yes" — templateSelection.jsx:349-360, src/translations/en.json eventCreation.handleTemplateDataReset

Save with mode auction and type "auction" → "Please select a valid auction strategy" — auctionConfiguration.jsx:421-424, src/translations/en.json errorMessages.quickCreateOrder.notAValidAuctionStrategy

Master QCS tab hidden for users whose team types include planner, and until at least one stage is non-draft; lot events get one Master QCS child per lot (`master_qcs?lotNo=`), plus a top-level one when `all_lots_withdrawn` — src/redux/project/selectors.js:39-40, 1408-1445

Title "Are you sure you want to award this vendor?", field "Quantity Offered *" pre-filled with the vendor's `participant_quantity` and unit suffix; info "TR is pending for this line item." when unscored — src/components/dataGrid/formatters/comparisonSelectionFormatter.jsx:29-74

BOQ projects: vendor header shows a checkbox "Select for awarding" / "Awarded"; unscored vendor → confirm "TR is pending for this vendor. Are you sure you want to proceed?" — src/components/dataGrid/formatters/comparisonHeaderFormatter.jsx:789-815, 1545-1557

On mount (not from PR) → `GET /v1/trade/new_request_config?additional_fields=terms_and_conditions` with `filters={"for_boq_based_project":true}` only for BOQ projects; filters are JSON spliced into the URL unencoded — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:2139-2148, src/redux/orders/actions.

Each draft stage → `GET /v1/trade/:id/schema?response_type=template&additional_fields=order_details&l1_prices=true` (plus `&rfq_to_auction=true` when converting), then `GET /companies/audience_for_product?trade_request_uuid=<id>` — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:1143-1165, src/models/

Stage `status` in the payload = `"draft"` whenever a project id is attached or publishToDraft is true, else `"active"`; so eRFX stages are always created as drafts and go live only through the project PATCH — src/views/projectCreation/helpers.js:999-1000

`show_under_open_events` defaults to `true` and is sent on every publish/save even when the "Publish as open tender" checkbox is hidden (template config `openTenderEnabled` off) — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:218, 1565, 1867, src/views/eventCreation/components/footer/confirmModal.js
`terms_and_conditions` is ALWAYS present in the body, even when the caller passed no T&C (clauses undefined, attachments value []) — src/redux/project/actions.js:71-82

mode `auction`, type `Rank`, strategy `rank`, closingOn `lot_based`, rfpEvaluationOn `line_item_based`, rfpCreationOn `template`, trafficType price, offersOn base price, dutchClosingOn single vendor — src/views/projectCreation/helpers.js:61-95
Clara summary panel renders when `isClaraEnabled` is FALSE and the project has a claraSummary (FE-15.2 states the inverse) — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:3405-3409

Publish with empty project title → "Please fill project title!" before any other check; a whitespace-only title passes (truthiness check) — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:1599-1602
Publish label: "Send to Auction team" when publishToDraft, "Save Recurring Event" when the CURRENT stage is recurring, else "Publish" — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:3390-3400

Stage title "" (auto titles are never empty; reachable in single-stage quick-create) → `errors.title`, no specific toast, only the rollup "<title> - There are some errors in Title, please check and try again" when no other toast fired; not raised for basket + multi-product — src/views/projectCreatio

Non-project publish → "Event sent to Auction Team successfully" when publishToDraft else "Event created successfully"; eRFX redirects to the project of the first stage, classic to `/orders/:id?tab=<eventDetails>` — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:1891-1914

Sheet product edits locked for RFQ→Auction ("You cannot make changes to the product because you are creating this event from an existing RFQ"), PR ("…from an existing PR") and non-BOQ project creation ("You can manage the product and quantity from the Manage Line Items section"); BOQ+PR unlocks; "Up

cases.title: Publish is blocked when no template or BOQ sheet is provided

cases.setup: Open /orders/quick-create with no template and no BOQ sheet.
